studies.description: Studies matching query.* searches and filter.* filters (1,000 a page, cursor paging with pageToken).

query.cond.desc: condition or disease (Essie expression), e.g. sickle cell

query.term.desc: other terms anywhere in the record

query.id.desc: study ids (NCT, org study id, secondary ids)

query.patient.desc: patient-oriented search (like the website's search box)

filter.overallStatus.desc: status list: RECRUITING, NOT_YET_RECRUITING, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION, COMPLETED, SUSPENDED, TERMINATED, WITHDRAWN, UNKNOWN (list or a|b)

fields.desc: fields to return (piece names such as NCTId, BriefTitle, OverallStatus, Phase, EnrollmentCount; list or a|b)

phase.desc: convenience: EARLY_PHASE1, PHASE1, PHASE2, PHASE3, PHASE4 or NA (list allowed); added to aggFilters

study_type.desc: convenience: INTERVENTIONAL, OBSERVATIONAL or EXPANDED_ACCESS; added to aggFilters

study.description: One study record (all modules, or the fields given).

field_values.description: Counts of studies by the values of one field across the whole registry (e.g. Phase, OverallStatus, LeadSponsorClass).

fields.desc: one field piece name, e.g. Phase

types.desc: ENUM, STRING, DATE, INTEGER, NUMBER, BOOLEAN

enums.note: aggFilters phase codes verified 2026-10-20 against /stats/field/values counts (phase:0 = EARLY_PHASE1 6,510; phase:NA = 239,209); early_phase1 and not_applicable codes match nothing.
